title: I'm building a mazing roguelike TD where you sculpt the maze with blocks mid-wave, earn gold and buy better towers & relics. It's claymation. Aliens in hats. Looking for iOS playtesters.
author: maxel100
selftext:
Hey! I'm Max, a solo ai-dev, long-time hat wearer.   
  
I've been building **Hat Invasion** superpowered by Fable & Grok. 

The core loop, in TD terms:

* **You build the maze yourself** from drawn from a deck, and turrets mount on the walls. Placing is live — you can wall mid-wave and reroute a column that's already marching.
* **Runs, not levels.** Branching map (elites, events, shops), relics, and a run-start bargain where the juicy picks hide an empowered enemy that ambushes you later in the run. You can see each act's boss from battle 1, so you draft toward the answer.
* **Bosses variety**, some cracks your wall pieces back into your hand, one eats them, one lobs eggs *behind* your kill zone, one petrifies pieces into rock.
* Large variety of **quirky enemies** with unique properties. 

If your a fan of **Emberward or Bloons TD** this is like its quirky brother.  With a stronger focus on the economy layer, trade-off your limited inventory, more variety in map design.

The art style is cute and weird claymation — the invaders are aliens whose hats are their power source, invading a clay Earth.

**Playtest:** iOS only right now (TestFlight). Comment or DM and I'll send an invite. I especially want to know where difficulty spikes, UI/FTUE improvement and anything else you can help with to make this as fun as possible.  
  
Happy to go deep on any of the design in the comments.
